_doc: Planning Commission members (commissioners), same schema as councilmembers.json. The Planning Commission is a separate body from City Council with different people. Sitting members and their term ends come from the city's published roster; everyone else was recovered from the roll calls in the parsed Planning Commission minutes. TERM STARTS ARE NOT RESEARCHED. Where a member's first recorded vote falls well after the archive's own first meeting (2024-07-09) that date is used as the start, on the same last-recorded-vote convention as `end` below; where their first vote IS that first meeting, their joining predates the record and the start stays null. The `end` on a member no longer serving is the date of their LAST RECORDED VOTE in the minutes, not a researched term end — it is set so the member reads as past rather than current, and should be replaced with the real date when known. Note that Craig Whiting is the same person as the councilmember of that name: he served here through December 2025 and joined the City Council on 1 January 2026, which is why a council name appears in this file. Extend `aliases` whenever OCR or speech-to-text introduces a new spelling.
